name: Anakin Skills
tagline: Skills for using Anakin's web data tools: scraping, research, Wire actions, monitors and browser tasks
description: Five skills that teach Cline when and how to use Anakin's tools: anakin-web-data (scrape, map, crawl), anakin-research (search, deep research, AI answer-engine comparison), anakin-wire (pre-built actions on 1,000+ websites), anakin-monitoring (scheduled change detection with alerts) and anakin-browser (AI-driven cloud browser tasks and saved logins). Use them with the Anakin MCP server.
